I don't think that's correct, since _input_ is bitmap data, not an ImageBitmap. The spec says

> An ImageBitmap object whose [[Detached]] internal slot value is false always has associated bitmap data, with a width and a height.

but doesn't have `<dfn>`s around width and height here (which IMO is fine).
